summary: Shows progress through a multi-step process and, optionally, lets users go back to completed steps.
whenNotToUse: Independent sections that can be viewed in any order: use Tabs.

props.name: currentStep
props.description: Index (0-based) of the current step. State is always owned by the consumer.

props.name: onStepPress
props.description: When provided, completed steps become buttons.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Below a 560 px container it becomes vertical regardless.

keyboard.action: Reaches and activates completed steps (if onStepPress is provided).

accessibility: Ordered list; the current step has aria-current="step".
The status (completed, current, error) is announced with translatable hidden text, in addition to icon and color.
responsive: Container query: below 560 px it automatically switches to the vertical layout.
commonMistakes: Allowing users to jump to future steps that have not been validated.
Not moving focus to the start of the new content when the step changes.

examples.name: GuidedForm
examples.title: Guided form with validation
examples.description: Next validates the step's fields: if data is missing the step shows hasError; completed steps let users go back.
